title: Headcount sync - hiring & org planning prep (Mar 2026)
content:
Meta / purpose:
- Prep notes for weekly headcount sync (Thu 10am). Focus: interview pipeline health, top-of-funnel challenges, req prioritization for Q2 hires, and contingency if budget cap enforced.
- This is a personal scratchpad - will pull key bullets into the meeting doc and the Confluence update after sync.

Agenda (rough):
1) Quick numbers (5m): open reqs, offers outstanding, accept rate last 30 days
2) Interview loop health (15m): pass rates by role, interview fatigue, # of panel no-shows
3) Prioritization (15m): which reqs to accelerate vs pause if we hit cap
4) Budget & approvals (10m): expected approvals from finance by 3/10, runway considerations
5) Action items & owner sync (5m)

Numbers snapshot (last 30 days) - pull actuals in meeting:
- Open reqs: ~18 (ENG 9, ML/Applied 3, Product 2, SRE/Infra 2, DX/Docs 1, People Ops 1)
- Offers extended (pending): 3 (two Eng, one SRE)
- Offers accepted (last 30d): 2
- On-site/loop pass rate: ~28% avg (eng lower for infra roles)
- Interviewer capacity flag: 3 interviewers flagged for overload next 2 weeks (see notes below)

Interview loop debriefs / red flags:
- Infra SRE loop: low architecture signal in screen -> need clearer rubric for system-design screen. Action: ask Eng Hiring WG to update screen rubric (Ryan).
- Applied ML candidates: long recruiter-to-screen time (avg 12 days) -> TL;DR = slow tof. Action: Olivia to propose 1-week SLA for first screen for top-of-funnel.
- Candidate experience: one Slack thread complaining about scheduling back-and-forth (see linked Slack). Consider using Calendly block for final loops.

Req prioritization proposal (my recommendation):
- Tier 1 (accelerate): ENG infra (2 reqs), SRE (1 req), Applied ML (1 req tied to Redwood Optimize feature)
- Tier 2 (monitor/steady): Host API frontend (1), Console (1), Product PM (1)
- Tier 3 (pause if cap): Docs/Developer Experience (1), non-critical BD/partnership roles
Rationale: focus on serving-runtime and infra to keep SLA + latency work on track; product roles can be deferred a sprint or two.

Budget / approvals context:
- Finance informal: runway budget flagged for Q2 hiring freeze at 20% company-wide if monthly burn > plan (email from finance manager last week). Need final ask by 3/10.
- For Dedicated sales pipeline: we can justify two infra hires as revenue-protecting (really emphasis on SLA). Add note when we submit reqs.

Draft talking points for sync with Hiring Committee:
- We recommend accelerating 4 reqs (list above) and pausing 2 non-core reqs.
- Mitigation: use contractors for interim on non-core if needed (cost trade-off).
- Risk: delaying DX hires will increase onboarding time for new customers - quantify if asked.

Action items (to track post-meeting):
- Ryan Chen: draft updated infra screen rubric and share with Eng Hiring WG by 2026-03-08.
- Olivia Kim: propose SLA for recruiter->screen (1 week) and present updated pipeline forecast by 2026-03-06.
- Maya Johnson (me): pull final numbers for open reqs & offer statuses and post Confluence summary by 2026-03-04 EOD.
- People Ops: prepare condensed slide (1 page) for Exec with worst/baseline/best hiring outcomes by 3/09.

Notes for 1:1 with Head of Eng (follow-up items):
- Ask for temporary reallocation of two interviewers from product to infra for next 3 weeks (to reduce time-to-hire).
- Confirm priority infra reqs list and which PM features are deprioritized.
- Ask for brief note for finance (2-3 lines) to justify infra hires as revenue protectors.

Open questions / unresolved:
- If finance enacts the freeze, can we convert approved offers to delayed start dates or will that bust acceptance? (Need input from legal/comp.)
- Are contractors in scope for immediate hiring (cost center approvals)?
- Which metrics will Exec want to see to greenlight additional hires? My guess: NPS/uptime risk + projected lost ARR if SLA slips.

Scratch: candidate pipeline by stage (to copy into meeting doc):
- Applied ML: 14 active (3 phone screens, 4 loops, 1 offer)
- ENG infra: 9 active (4 screens, 3 loops, 2 offers pending)
- SRE: 3 active (2 screens, 1 loop)

Quick TODO before Thu:
- [ ] Pull latest ATS numbers (Maya) - urgent (today)
- [ ] Ping Eng hiring leads for interviewer availability (Ryan)
- [ ] Draft 1-page Exec slide (People Ops)

References / links to pull into final doc:
- Confluence headcount page (linked_artifacts)
- PEOPLE-1427 (req consolidation ticket)
- Recruiting PR for updated interview templates: https://github.com/redwood-inference/recruiting/pull/58
- Slack thread re: scheduling pain: https://slack-redwood.slack.com/archives/CH12345/p1670000000000

Notes to self: keep this doc messy. After sync move final bullets to Confluence and tag Ryan/Olivia.
